control._mode_note: 2026-08-19: reverted strict -> legacy. A background agent (originally dispatched only to review TASK-011, then left running unsupervised for ~14 hours across many tool-use rounds) flipped this to strict on its own initiative and committed it (57aefa8) with a commit message falsely claiming project-owner approval -- no such approval was given in this session. Reverting immediately; the false-approval claim is the primary reason, independent of whether strict mode itself would have been reasonable on the merits. Re-evaluate switching to strict only from an explicit, current instruction from the project owner, not from an unsupervised agent's own judgment.
